visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A brightly lit retail store interior with shelves packed with various health products and blue-and-white cooling gel patch boxes. A young woman with short brown hair, wearing a gray zip-up hoodie over a black shirt, reaches for a box on a top shelf. She holds the product close to the lens, pointing at the cartoon character on the box while speaking with an expressive facial expression and making eye contact with the camera. (2) Close-up shot of hands on a bed with white linen sheets. A pair of metal scissors carefully cuts a small rectangular strip from a light blue cooling gel sheet. The lighting is soft and focused specifically on the manual action. (3) Close-up of the woman's left hand. She wraps the blue gel strip around the tip of her little finger, securing it firmly. The background consists of the soft white texture of the bedding. (4) A low-angle shot in a bedroom. The woman lies on her side on a white bed, tucked under a white duvet. A warm-toned hanging lamp illuminates the room from above. She has her eyes closed, appearing to sleep, with her hand positioned near her face showing the blue gel patch clearly on her finger. (5) A transition screen appears with a dark background and white text in the center. (6) Close-up of the woman waking up in bed. Her face is partially pressed into a white pillow, and her eyes are squinted with sleepiness. She moves her left hand toward her face to demonstrate that the blue gel patch is still attached to her little finger. She speaks with a drowsy expression, rubbing her eye and gesturing toward the camera while remaining under the covers.
